The way in · qualitative · not legal advice

What lawful entry involves, in order

Who may hold
No nationality restriction on buying rural land; a tax number is needed. Decreto-Lei 555/99 (consolidated)
How a group can hold
Cooperativa Agrícola Associação
  • Cooperativa Agrícola. Recognised agricultural co-operative form. Decreto-Lei 335/99
  • Associação. Civil-code association (arts. 157 ff.). Código Civil
First claim
No statutory pre-emption holder identified for rural land in the sources opened.
Direction
Residency-by-investment route for real estate removed in October 2023.tightening · as of 2026
  1. Check the parcel against the protected-zone maps before any offer.
    Who decides: Municipal chamber / regional planning office Decreto-Lei 555/99 (consolidated)
  2. Ask the chamber in writing whether a dwelling is permissible on the parcel.
    Who must say yes: Municipal chamber Duration: residency processing 12-18 months as of 2024 AIMA Decreto-Lei 555/99 (consolidated)
What the law rules out
  • Buying land does not by itself carry water rights or a right to build.
Honest gaps
  • Whether scheme water allocations transfer with the parcel was not covered by a primary source.
None is shown.
